selfReferral.title: Pharmacy First
selfReferral.copy: Your local pharmacy can treat seven common conditions — including earache, sore throat, sinusitis and urinary infections — and prescribe where appropriate, no appointment needed.

selfReferral.title: First-contact physiotherapy
selfReferral.copy: Muscle, joint and back problems can be booked straight in with our physiotherapist — no GP appointment first. Book the same way as any appointment.

selfReferral.title: NHS Talking Therapies
selfReferral.copy: Free, confidential support for stress, anxiety and low mood. Refer yourself directly online or by phone — you do not need to see a GP first.

selfReferral.title: Sexual health services
selfReferral.copy: Contraception, testing and advice through local sexual health clinics, booked directly and in confidence.

selfReferral.title: Stop smoking support
selfReferral.copy: Free local support that makes you three times more likely to quit for good. Sign up directly — no GP appointment needed.
